hero.title: About VetSphere
hero.subtitle: Dedicated to providing trusted veterinary knowledge for farmers and pet owners worldwide.

founder.name: Mathews Chilongo
founder.title: Founder & Author
founder.bio: I created VetSphere out of a passion for animal health and a desire to make reliable veterinary knowledge accessible to everyone — whether you're a farmer in rural Africa, a pet owner in a city, or anywhere in between. My goal is to provide practical, accurate, and free information that helps you take better care of your animals.

mission: Empowering farmers and pet owners worldwide with accurate veterinary knowledge and practical tools for better animal health outcomes.
vision: A world where every farmer and pet owner has free access to reliable, professional veterinary guidance regardless of their location.

values.title: Livestock Focus
values.desc: Practical advice for cattle, goats, poultry, pigs and more — covering disease prevention, nutrition, and herd management.

values.title: Pet Care
values.desc: Trusted guidance for dogs, cats and small animals to keep your pets healthy, happy and living their best lives.

values.title: Worldwide Reach
values.desc: While rooted in African veterinary challenges, our content is relevant and useful for farmers and pet owners across the globe.

values.title: Always Free
values.desc: All our articles and resources are completely free. We believe quality veterinary knowledge should be accessible to everyone.
